intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A loose festival ribbon bobs against a post, trailing a long gold streamer into the water.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Every festival, the surface ties ribbons to everything. Every festival, the ribbons try to escape.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “That depends. Is it likely to tangle a boat?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Last year one caught a rowing boat by the oar. The rower spent an hour going festively in circles.”

options.labelText: “Then it comes out. That rower has suffered enough.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She hooks the ribbon with one fin and flips it up onto the stones at your feet.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “There. The celebrating is yours. Please do it somewhere dry.”

options.labelText: “Leave it, it’s pretty. Honestly, the water could use a few more.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “The sea already has a rather successful decorating department.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Out on the water, a small boat begins to turn in a slow, festive circle.
